title: Patterns
examples: Teacher, what shape comes next in this line?
Can you show me a pattern with three different shapes?

explain.say: Look at the shapes. Red, blue, red, blue. Say the colours with me.
Red and blue repeat again and again. That is a pattern. It is called an AB pattern.
Now look at circle, square, square. Then circle, square, square again. This is an ABB pattern.
Here are three shapes. Triangle, circle, square, then triangle, circle, square. This is an ABC pattern.
To find what comes next, say the pattern out loud. Red, green, blue, red, green, blue. After blue comes red again.

faq.q: What does it mean to spot a pattern?
faq.a: It means you see what repeats. Then you can say what comes next.
asks: How do I find the pattern?
What is the rule for this group?

faq.q: If the pattern is circle, square, circle, square, what comes next?
faq.a: The pattern repeats circle, square. So the next shape is a circle.

faq.q: Can I use more than three shapes in a pattern?
faq.a: Yes, you can use many shapes. The pattern just needs to repeat in the same order.
asks: What if I use four shapes?
Does the pattern have to be short?

faq.q: What if the pattern seems wrong?
faq.a: Say the pattern out loud from the start. Then look for the shape that breaks the order.
asks: How do I fix this pattern?
Is this shape in the right place?

faq.q: Is 'AB' the same as 'A A B B'?
faq.a: No, they are different patterns. AB means one A, then one B. AABB means two As, then two Bs.
asks: What is the difference between AB and AABB?
Can you show me two different patterns?

facts: Patterns are things that repeat in a regular order.
An AB pattern repeats two different things.
An ABC pattern repeats three different things.
You can find patterns in nature, like leaves or stripes.

quiz.say: Look at the pattern. Tap the shape that comes next.
quiz.why: The pattern goes circle, triangle, again and again. After a triangle comes a circle.

wrong.0: A triangle came last, so the pattern starts again with a circle.
wrong.2: This pattern uses just circles and triangles.

quiz.say: Say the colours. Tap the colour that comes next.
quiz.why: The pattern is red, blue, blue, again and again. After two blues comes red.

wrong.0: There are already two blues, so the pattern starts again with red.
wrong.1: This pattern uses just red and blue.

quiz.say: Look at the fruit pattern. Tap what comes next.
quiz.why: The pattern is apple, banana, grapes. After the banana come the grapes.

wrong.1: The apple comes after the grapes, so the grapes come first.
wrong.2: A banana came last, so the grapes come next.
